result.instruction: In `byte_fifo`, replace the `integer read_ptr` and `integer write_ptr` declarations with unsigned registers sized to represent `0` through `DEPTH-1`, using at least one bit. Keep the existing explicit terminal-value wrap logic and preserve FIFO ordering, simultaneous enqueue/dequeue, occupancy-based ready/valid behavior, and synchronous reset. Preserve supported `DEPTH` behavior and the top’s cycle behavior; do not add a numeric top latency annotation. Promotion still requires all verification and routed metric gates, plus a strict LUT reduction or equal LUTs with fewer FFs than the incumbent.
